label: Subscribe Webhook
description: Subscribe a Make webhook URL to one of the 8 NxtSend events. Returns {id, event, target_url}; the HMAC secret is server-side only.

parameters.name: event
parameters.label: Event (lead.created, lead.updated, lead.added_to_campaign, lead.removed_from_campaign, campaign.created, campaign.status_changed, conversation.reply_created, subscription.changed)

notes: SKELETON — part of the Make custom-app spec (see integrations/make/app.json). Build this module in Make's web UI / VS Code from this spec; the endpoint (method + path) is the contract the module must call.
